newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RAUL SIGNS NEW CONTRACT WITH REAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAUL SIGNS NEW CONTRACT WITH REAL.

text.p: Real Madrid's teenage striker Raul Gonzalez signed a new contract worth an estimated 300 million pesetas per year ($2.08 million) on Wednesday, just two days after playing his 100th game for the club.
The deal will commit Raul, 19, to the club until 2002. Any team wanting to buy the international will now have to pay Real Madrid six billion pesetas ($41.2 million).
"It's a good contract. I've got a lot left to do, but it gives me tranquility to work," said Raul, who left to give blood in a Madrid hospital immediately after signing the contract.
Raul started his career at Atletico Madrid, but made the move across the Spanish capital after the Atletico's junior teams were scrapped to cut costs.

He led the Under-21 team to the final of the European championships and Olympic quarter-finals, finally doing enough to convince Javier Clemente he was ready to be blooded at full international level.
"I'm very happy with the agreement...Raul is the future of Real Madrid," said his club coach Fabio Capello.
